scope: Frozen one-shot retrospective Scania APS benchmark; scored-record metrics with coverage, not field or future-failure performance.
dataset: APS Failure at Scania Trucks (Scania CV AB / UCI 421; DOI 10.24432/C51S51)
overlap_limit: The 128 unscored records were excluded from this overlap check. The reported zero cross-file overlap does not establish zero overlap across all 16,000 input records or independence between vehicles or time periods.
interpretation: Positive means a recorded APS-related component fault; negative means another recorded component fault, not a healthy truck.
Recall, precision and average precision exclude unscored records; coverage is reported alongside them.
No vehicle/time generalisation, prospective warning horizon, causal diagnosis, operational ROI or production acceptance is established.
